part.text:
Fixed. In `lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js`:

- `normalizeValue` now preserves arrays (`value.map(normalizeValue)`) instead of flattening them with `String(value)`, so `normalize()` no longer collapses `set-cookie` arrays into one comma-joined string (`lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js:14`).
- `toJSON(asStrings)` only joins array values when `asStrings` is explicitly requested, matching `response.headers.get('set-cookie')` returning an array as in 0.27.x (`lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js:369`).

Both failing evaluation tests now pass (`AxiosHeaders normalize() should support array values` and `issues/5028 should handle set-cookie headers as an array`); the only remaining failures are pre-existing network-dependent http adapter tests that also fail on the untouched baseline.
